features.title: Jump to date
features.summary: Open a room calendar and move directly to the first available message on or after a chosen date.

features.title: Polls
features.summary: Create single-choice Matrix polls, vote in the timeline, follow disclosed results, and close polls when the decision is complete.

snapshot.name: feature-polls
snapshot.alt: Charm conversation showing a disclosed poll and the create-poll dialog
snapshot.caption: Playwright renders live poll totals and opens the composer flow from a complete room timeline.

features.title: Encrypted local message search

snapshot.alt: Charm message search showing an encrypted local-index result
snapshot.caption: Playwright searches the current room and selects a result through the existing timeline navigation path.

features.title: Quick switcher

snapshot.alt: Charm quick switcher showing a fuzzy room result
snapshot.caption: Playwright opens the launcher from its keyboard binding and fuzzy-matches a joined room before navigating.

features.title: Guided onboarding

snapshot.alt: Charm welcome screen explaining rooms, messaging, and settings
snapshot.caption: The deterministic first-run welcome state captured by Playwright.

features.title: Interactive account registration
